tagline: A leading worldwide formulator, manufacturer and marketer of adhesives, sealants and other specialty chemical products
hero_kpi_rationale: Project ONE represents a major IT investment to transform operational efficiency, with structural impact on future costs and scalability. Cumulative amount of $265 million over 13 years of implementation, reflecting the scale of this cross-functional transformation.

kpis.name: Project ONE capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for Project ONE IT modernization initiative.
kpis.description: Total capital expenditures to date for Project ONE (approximately 60-65% of total spend). Total project expenditures estimated at $300-320 million, with approximately $265 million spent through November 29, 2025.
kpis.signal: Major strategic investment in IT transformation

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin estimated from sectoral context and operating margins. Consistent with specialty chemicals companies. Not explicitly disclosed in 10-K.
kpis.signal: Gross margin typical of specialty chemicals sector

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Estimated from restructuring costs and operating expenses. Consistent with industrial specialty chemicals profile. Not explicitly disclosed in 10-K.
kpis.signal: Moderate operating margin reflecting cost pressures

kpis.name: R&D investments as a percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Typical rate for specialty products company focused on application development rather than radical innovation. Not explicitly disclosed in 10-K.
kpis.signal: Moderate R&D typical of industrial specialty chemicals company

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Estimated based on presence in 34 countries and operating segment sizes. Not explicitly disclosed in 10-K.
kpis.signal: Global workforce consistent with mid-size multinational

kpis.name: Cumulative Restructuring Costs
kpis.explanation: Total costs incurred under restructuring plans approved in 2023.
kpis.description: Total costs incurred under restructuring plans launched in Q2-Q3 2023 to optimize operations and integrate acquisitions. Plans expected to cost $80.0-85.0 million total; $79.2 million incurred through November 29, 2025, with remaining cash payments continuing into fiscal 2026.
kpis.signal: Major restructuring plan completed as of November 29, 2025

kpis.name: Project ONE Cumulative Spending
kpis.explanation: Cumulative investment in IT modernization through Project ONE since inception.
kpis.description: Total project-to-date expenditures for Project ONE as of November 29, 2025, covering core transaction processing modernization across customer orders, procurement, manufacturing and financial reporting. Total estimated project cost $300-320 million with 60-65% capitalized.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to economic risks including recessions, which may negatively impact sales and profitability. Discretionary consumer spending is subject to reduction due to economic uncertainties. (Item 1A, p. 27)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to interest rate changes from floating rate credit facilities used to fund operations, affecting borrowing costs and profitability. (Item 7A, p. 27)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to foreign exchange risks across 34 countries of operations, which may impact sales and profitability. (Item 1A, p. 27)

risks.title: Raw Materials Price Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to raw materials price volatility, which may impact costs and profitability. (Item 1A, p. 28)

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company holds significant goodwill that may be impaired by economic fluctuations and business environment changes. Fair values of reporting units exceeded carrying values by 33-80% in 2025 impairment test. (Item 8, p. 16)

risks.title: Internal Controls Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company maintains internal controls but remains exposed to potential control failures or ineffectiveness. (Item 8, p. 16)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company is exposed to reputation risks as a global manufacturer and marketer in specialty chemicals, which could impact sales and brand value. (Item 1A, p. 26)

ai_positioning.summary: FUL does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related topics in its 2025 10-K filing. No AI strategies, initiatives or risks are disclosed.
